description: RYOBI introduces the 12V Cordless Rotary Tool Kit. This tool also features the new innovative QuickChange Collet with 4 times faster accessory changes, which makes switching accessories quick and easy. Backed by the RYOBI 3-Year Manufacturer's Warranty, the 12V Cordless Rotary Tool Kit includes 35 Accessories, 3 Attachments, Wrench, accessory storage case, USB Cable, and Operator's Manual
